rca of the issue: Previous crash root cause: GET /api/active-consultation returns {} when no in_consultation record exists. Original code tested `!active` (false for {}), so it attempted active.token_number.replace(...). Current App.js line 39 now guards with `!active?.id?<Notice...>` and renders the notice safely. Verified live by hitting /doctor with no active patient.
